This is the transition area that brings players from ''[[Guild Wars Factions|Factions]]'' to ''[[Guild Wars Eye of the North|Eye of the North]]''.

==Getting there==
Enter the [[chasm]] that [[spawn]]s in [[Bukdek Byway]] during the [[I Feel the Earth Move Under Cantha's Feet]] quest or after the completion of that quest, [[What Lies Beneath]] or [[Hole of Istan]].

==Quests available==
*[[The Beginning of the End]] (automatically acquired after the [[Encounter in the Depths]] [[cinematic]])
